name: zanza
description: rythem-trax — vinyl record store. packages/ui = design system (tokens + components), apps/storefront = the site.

scripts.build: node packages/ui/build-tokens.js && node packages/ui/build-docs.js && node apps/storefront/build.js
scripts.build:deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy
scripts.deploy:admin: node apps/admin/build.js && npx --yes wrangler@3.80.0 pages deploy apps/admin/dist --project-name store-admin --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.build:pages: node packages/ui/build-tokens.js && node packages/ui/build-docs.js && node apps/storefront/build.js --target=pages --source=supabase
